build: Development build on localhost, PayPal sandbox, Postgres 17

suites.name: Rules engine and routing
suites.what: Every rule row, the 2026 values, the $60 quarterly exclusion, shelter, ABLE and gift routing

suites.name: API end to end
suites.what: Gift checks, presets, bill and fundraiser reading, PayPal orders, routed gifts, receipts, the ledger, developer keys and every error path

suites.name: Browser end to end
suites.what: The Gift Checker, Try it, the gift page, keyboard use, and the developer flow from new key to a Claude-read bill

suites.name: Accessibility and layout
suites.what: axe WCAG 2.2 AA on 12 pages at desktop and phone widths, light and dark, with no sideways scroll

suites.name: Real PayPal checkout, logged in as the sandbox buyer
suites.what: Both PayPal buttons: the buyer logs in and approves, PayPal captures every payee, the page updates, and the public receipt matches

suites.name: Failure cases, live
suites.what: Run the seven failure cases on this page yourself
